title: Embrace – Embrace health care
text: Scroll to top How can we help? Ask me anything about our services… Self care Self care provides you assistance with personal tasks of daily life to develop skills that will help you live as autonomously as possible. Your self care plan includes Grooming and dressing Our grooming service for NDIS participants offers personalised care in hair styling, nail care, and oral hygiene. We focus on enhancing confidence and comfort, ensuring each individual feels well-groomed and dignified. Our team is sensitive to the unique preferences of each participant, providing a respectful, empowering experience. We understand grooming’s role in personal wellbeing, and we’re committed to delivering a service that respects the independence and individuality of every NDIS participant. Cleaning Our cleaning service offers comprehensive, specialised cleaning to NDIS participants, creating a hygienic and orderly home environment. We tailor our services to individual preferences, recognising the unique needs of each participant. From regular housekeeping to deep cleaning, our skilled team ensures every corner is meticulously maintained. We focus on using eco-friendly products and methods to safeguard the health of our clients. Our commitment is to provide a clean, safe, and comfortable living space that enhances the wellbeing and independence of NDIS participants. Eating Eating assistance is crucial for many NDIS participants. Our service provides empathetic and skilled support for meal preparation and eating, tailored to the dietary needs and preferences of each individual. We assist in the entire process, from grocery shopping and cooking to feeding, ensuring meals are not only nutritious but also enjoyable. Our staff are trained in dietary requirements and safe feeding practices, ensuring every meal is a pleasant, dignified experience. We aim to foster independence where possible, enhancing the daily living experience of participants through thoughtful and personalised support. Bathing Our bathing service for NDIS participants is designed with utmost respect for privacy and independence. We provide personalised assistance, ensuring safety and comfort during bathing or showering. Our staff are specially trained to offer support in a way that maintains dignity and respects personal boundaries. We focus on creating a relaxing environment, understanding that bathing is not just about hygiene but also a time for relaxation and rejuvenation. Our approach is to empower participants, assisting them as needed while encouraging self-sufficiency wherever possible. Dressing and undressing Dressing and undressing can be challenging for some NDIS participants. Our service offers respectful, personalised assistance in this daily task, ensuring comfort and promoting self-confidence. We assist with selecting appropriate attire, dressing, and undressing, all while respecting the individual’s choices and preferences. Our goal is to empower participants by providing support that fosters independence, helping them to start and end their day with dignity and ease. Toilet Toilet assistance is a sensitive aspect of daily care, and our service approaches it with the utmost respect for dignity and privacy. We offer discreet and compassionate support for toileting needs, focusing on hygiene and promoting independence. Our staff are trained to provide assistance in a way that respects the individual’s comfort and needs. We aim to make this essential aspect of daily life as dignified and stress-free as possible for NDIS participants. Mobility Enhancing mobility for NDIS participants is a key focus of our service. We provide customised support to help individuals move safely and confidently within their homes and communities. Our approach includes assistance with walking, transfers, and using mobility aids. We aim to enhance the independence and quality of life for participants by enabling greater access to their environment and activities they enjoy. Our staff are trained in safe handling techniques and are committed to empowering participants through respectful, supportive mobility assistance.
